# Akshat Kharbanda

> Independent strategist (The Business Backpacker) working on 0→1 strategy and operations: market shaping, go-to-market, AI systems and AI adoption, with a cross-cultural lens from work across India, Denmark, the UK and 30+ countries. INSEAD and BITS Pilani alumnus; formerly Novo Nordisk.

- [Case studies](https://akshatkharbanda.com/work): 17 projects across new markets, research, and building systems
